summary: A mill town comes to a hearing with money already spent on producing bag material.
realLife: Washington House report on ESSB 5323, 2020. House Finance testimony described the Port Angeles plant investing in retooling while other mills considered whether to follow.
inGame: needs: a mill has completed an investment and its neighbors are still weighing theirs.
gates: A mill has completed an investment and its neighbors are still weighing theirs.

turns.what: The converted mill brings a purchase order to the hearing.
turns.pulledBy: An order fills the converted line.
turns.writesBack: The mill can show members what its investment produces.

turns.what: The next mill waits for a firm buyer.
turns.pulledBy: An interested buyer leaves quantities open.
turns.writesBack: Other mills defer their conversion decisions.
